subject: English Home Language
atp_edition: undated (DBE Grade R Resource Kit 'Laying Solid Foundations for Learning')
basis: DBE Grade R Resource Kit lesson plans (no ATP published)
lesson_scope: Foundation Phase reading, writing, phonics and handwriting

terms.theme: My body; My senses; My family; Keeping clean and fit; Healthy eating

topics.name: My body: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Afro Ant's Adventure and answers questions about it
Talks about own body, what the body parts are used for and how the body has changed since being a baby
Names body parts and the actions performed on Poster 1 (My body)
Sings and recites body songs and rhymes (e.g. Head and shoulders, knees and toes)

topics.name: My body: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'a' sound at the beginning of words
Segments own name into syllables (clapping)
Matches labels to body parts on the poster; 'reads' sentence strips with the teacher
Reads action words (run, walk, hop) with picture support; builds the sentence 'I ___'

topics.name: My body: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'a' (sandpaper, sand trays, chalk; assessment wheel)
Makes a 'Me book' with drawings and action-word sentences

topics.name: My senses: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Vusi and the vuvuzela and shows understanding of it
Talks about how we experience the world through the five senses
Matches items to the sense used (e.g. flower and nose); visual memory game with items on a tray
Sings and recites songs and rhymes

topics.name: My senses: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'v' sound at the beginning of words
'Reads' sentence strips: I (see, hear, touch, smell, taste) with my ___

topics.name: My senses: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'v'
Makes a book of senses from magazine pictures; says a sentence about a picture for the teacher to scribe

topics.name: My family: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story A surprise for Gogo and shows understanding of it
Talks about members of a family and the roles they have
Matches personal items to family members and explains the reasoning

topics.name: My family: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'g' sound at the beginning of words
Claps the syllables of family names (mo-ther, fa-ther) and completes words from an initial syllable
Reads single words and matches them to family members; 'reads' sentence strips ('Who am I?' / 'I am the ___')

topics.name: My family: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'g'
Makes a small 'Who am I?' book with pictures and sentences about the family

topics.name: Keeping clean and fit: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Dirty Duduzile and shows understanding of it
Talks about how to keep clean and fit and look after the body; describes Poster 4
Sings and recites songs; names items on the theme table

topics.name: Keeping clean and fit: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'j' and 'm' sounds at the beginning of words; finds classroom items beginning with 'm'
'Reads' theme flashcards and mimes the action; matches items to flashcards
'Reads' sentence strips: I use ___ (soap, shampoo, etc.)

topics.name: Keeping clean and fit: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'j' and 'm' (tracing in jelly powder, chalk letters on the ground)
Makes an 'm' picture collage from magazines

topics.name: Healthy eating: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Mmm, mud pies! and shows understanding of it
Talks about how to make good food choices
Sings and recites songs

topics.name: Healthy eating: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'k' and 'i' sounds at the beginning of words
Says the initial sound of food pictures and sorts food items into letter sound bags
'Reads' sentence strips: I like ___ (chicken, eggs, etc.)

topics.name: Healthy eating: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'k' and 'i' (painting with water, stick-and-ink designs)

sba: Literacy assessment (weeks 1-2): letter 'a' formation wheel and initial 'a' words; name body parts and actions on Poster 1; build and 'read' the sentence 'I ___' (holistic rubric)
Literacy assessment (weeks 3-4): letter 'v' formation wheel; name the senses (Worksheet 2); build the sentence 'I ___ with my ___'
Literacy assessment (weeks 5-6): letter 'g' formation wheel; name family members and clap syllables (Worksheet 3); sentence 'I am the ___'
Literacy assessment (weeks 7-8): letter 'm' formation wheel and 'm' items; describe Poster 4 and match items to flashcards; sentence 'I use ___'
Literacy assessment (weeks 9-10): letter 'k' formation wheel; initial sounds of food pictures (Worksheet 4); sentence 'I like ___'

terms.theme: Friends; This is what I wear; Shapes and colours in my community; Opposites; Gardens and bugs

topics.name: Friends: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Proud to be me and shows understanding of it
Talks about how to be a good friend and describes how to make and treat friends

topics.name: Friends: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'n' sound at the beginning of words
Builds own name with magnetic letters and says the sound of each letter
'Reads' sentence strips: This is my friend ___ (matching name labels and photographs)

topics.name: Friends: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'n'
Writes the letters of own name (playdough letter cutters)
Makes a small 'Who is this?' book about a friend

topics.name: This is what I wear: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Ntombi Hippo and shows understanding of it
Describes items of clothing, the season and the place or occasion when they are worn

topics.name: This is what I wear: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'e' sound at the beginning of words; recognises letters introduced so far
'Reads' sentence strips: I have a ___ in my suitcase (scarf, hat, shirt, etc.)

topics.name: This is what I wear: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'e'
Makes a small 'What do I have in my suitcase?' book with a picture and sentence per page

topics.name: Shapes and colours in my community: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Yellow Yolanda and shows understanding of it
Names shapes and describes their properties; names colours

topics.name: Shapes and colours in my community: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'y' and 'o' sounds at the beginning of words
'Reads' sentence strips: This is a ___ (circle, square, etc.); reads and names colour words (Worksheet 1)

topics.name: Shapes and colours in my community: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'y' and 'o'
Makes a small shape book: pastes a coloured shape and writes a sentence ('This is a red square')

topics.name: Opposites: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Friends and shows understanding of it
Names words and their opposites; says the opposite of a called-out word

topics.name: Opposites: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'x' sound at the beginning of words
Matches pairs of opposite word cards; plays an opposites memory game with theme cards
'Reads' sentence strips: Look at the ___ (tall man, fat cat, etc.)

topics.name: Opposites: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'x'
Makes a small 'Look at the ___' book with pictures and sentence strips

topics.name: Gardens and bugs: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Fastest, smartest flea! and shows understanding of it
Names insects on Poster 10, describes their appearance and talks about insects seen

topics.name: Gardens and bugs: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'w' and 'z' sounds at the beginning of words
Claps the syllables in insect names
'Reads' sentence strips: I see the ___ (spider, fly, bee, etc.)

topics.name: Gardens and bugs: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'w' and 'z'
Makes a small insect-shaped book with a picture and description on each page

sba: Literacy assessment (weeks 11-12): letter 'n' formation wheel; build own name with magnetic letters (Worksheet 4); sentence 'This is my friend ___'
Literacy assessment (weeks 13-14): letter 'e' and letters so far; describe clothing, season and occasion; sentence 'I have a ___' (checklist)
Literacy assessment (weeks 15-16): letter 'y' formation wheel; name shapes and colours (Worksheet 1); sentence 'This is a ___'
Literacy assessment (weeks 17-18): letter 'x'; match opposite word cards; sentence 'Look at the ___' (holistic rubric)
Literacy assessment (weeks 19-20): letter 'w' formation wheel; name and describe insects on Poster 10 and clap syllables; sentence 'I see the ___'

terms.theme: Time and weather; Keeping safe; The sky (day and night); People who help us; Helping hands

topics.name: Time and weather: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Clouds, uses picture clues to predict it and retells it
Sings songs (e.g. Good morning Mr Sun; This is the way we wash our clothes)
Tells what the weather is like and completes the weather chart

topics.name: Time and weather: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'c' (hard c) sound at the beginning of words; slow-speaks words (c-a-t)
Sorts toys into those that begin with 'c' and those that don't
Matches weather words on cut flashcards; 'reads' item labels on lotto boards
'Reads' the sentence strip: Today is ___

topics.name: Time and weather: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Copies 'c' onto pegboards
Writes simple weather sentences with the teacher's help and reads them to the class

topics.name: Keeping safe: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story A boy's best friend and shows understanding of it
Uses picture clues to investigate safe and unsafe situations; discusses how fire is a help and a danger

topics.name: Keeping safe: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'f' sound at the beginning of words and the sound objects begin with
Segments words into syllables (clapping) and uses each word in an oral sentence
Interprets common warning symbols (e.g. STOP) and 'reads' safe/unsafe product labels

topics.name: Keeping safe: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'f' (red plasticine 'f', copying 'f' in red crayon)

topics.name: The sky (day and night): Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Queen Quellerina, uses picture clues to predict it and dramatises it
Talks about pictures drawn in own sky book

topics.name: The sky (day and night): Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'q(u)' sound at the beginning of words (quick, quiet, queen)
Identifies words that rhyme with sky, moon, queen, etc.
Makes an emergent reader 'My sky book', completing 'It is day. I see a ...' / 'It is night. I see a ...' and reads it back

topics.name: The sky (day and night): Emergent Writing
subtopics: Traces letter 'q' templates to make 'q' mobiles

topics.name: People who help us: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Our goat Godfrey and shows understanding of it
Shares personal stories of being lost; identifies people in the community who help us (Poster 14): what they do, where they work, what they wear

topics.name: People who help us: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'p' and 't' sounds at the beginning of words and initial and end sounds of community workers' names
Recognises (reads) initial sounds learned so far (letter dice); says 'My name begins with ...'

topics.name: People who help us: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'p' and 't' (walking large chalk letters, pipe-cleaner and plasticine letters)

topics.name: Helping hands: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story I like to help and uses the illustrations to identify objects and experiences
Recounts personal stories of helping others; talks about being young and old and names for grandparents

topics.name: Helping hands: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'h' sound at the beginning of words and recognises the symbol 'h'
'Reads' letters c, p, t, s, h, q and makes a word beginning with each sound
'Reads' own 'I like to help' book, pointing to the words; knows front and back of a book

topics.name: Helping hands: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'h' ('h' mobiles)
Makes own book 'I like to help at home' with illustrations and captions

sba: Literacy assessment (weeks 21-22): initial 'c' sound with picture cards; sing a theme song; complete weather chart and 'Today is ...'; retell the story Clouds (holistic rubric)
Literacy assessment (weeks 23-24): letter 'f' formation wheel; clap syllables of pictures (Worksheet 1); 'read' warning signs (Worksheet 3)
Literacy assessment (weeks 25-26): rhyming picture cards; initial 'q(u)' words; read own 'My sky book' (checklist)
Literacy assessment (weeks 27-28): letters 'p' and 't' formation wheel; letter dice words; oral task on community helpers with Poster 14
Literacy assessment (weeks 29-30): retell tasks from I like to help; sort 'h' picture cards; 'read' letters c, p, t, s, h, q; read own book (checklist)

terms.theme: New life; This is where people live

topics.name: New life: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story A spring surprise; follows single and multiple verbal instructions
Recounts personal experiences of events that surprised them or a family member
Answers questions about an animal (name, where it lives) in pairs or small groups

topics.name: New life: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'b' sound at the beginning of words and recognises the symbol 'b'
Identifies rhyming words in the story and makes up other rhyming words
'Reads' names of baby and adult animals; makes a class reader and 'reads' from it, pointing to the words

topics.name: New life: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'b' (salt-dough 'b')
Draws baby animals and their mothers and uses known letters to label them

topics.name: This is where people live: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Listens to the Big Book story Who lives here? and retells it; compares homes for people and for animals
Talks about types of homes, rooms and what learners did at home that morning

topics.name: This is where people live: Emergent Reading and Phonics
subtopics: Phonics: identifies the 'd' sound at the beginning of words (door, desk, dog, donkey)
Counts how many times the 'd' sound is heard in 'doodle'
Reads along with the repetitive story text; completes the sentence strip 'Where do you live? I live in a ...'

topics.name: This is where people live: Emergent Writing
subtopics: Letter formation of 'd' (sand tray, chalk, sawdust letter)
Makes a little 'Where do you live?' book with a drawing and label of own home; labels own home on a local map

sba: Listening assessment (weeks 31-32): follow single and multiple verbal instructions with picture cards; rhyming words; answer questions about an animal in a group
